label: class_a_07_ecology_01
text: Hello, hello. I hope everyone’s ready to learn\nsome new things today![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: class_a_07_ecology_02
text: Next time we meet, we’ll have our final exam.\nThat means today is our last actual class.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: class_a_07_ecology_03
text: And the topic for this last class will be...Pokémon\n[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]forms[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]! You can just think of forms as the shapes\r\nor appearances that Pokémon have.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: class_a_07_ecology_04
text: There’s also a phenomenon called a [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]form[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]\n[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]change[VAR 0xFF00(0000)], where a Pokémon’s appearance\r\nchanges under certain conditions.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: class_a_07_ecology_05
text: Cyclizar, for example, which we regularly ride on\nas transportation here in Paldea, has three forms.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: class_a_07_ecology_06
text: First is its basic form, where it walks on four\nlegs. Second is its battle form, where it stands\r\non its hind legs to engage in battle.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: class_a_07_ecology_07
text: Finally, there’s its ride form, where it inflates its\nthroat sac and its tail so we can ride on its back.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: class_a_07_ecology_08
text: Though we can use something you’re all carrying\nwith you now as an even better example![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: class_a_07_ecology_09
text: Yup, I’m talking about your phones! Some\nsmartphones are inhabited by a certain Pokémon.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: class_a_07_ecology_10
text: Does anyone know the Pokémon I’m referring to?[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: class_a_07_select_01
text: Rotom

label: class_a_07_select_02
text: Pikachu

label: class_a_07_select_03
text: Heracross

label: class_a_07_ecology_answer_01
text: You’re a regular expert on Pokémon AND\ntechnology, aren’t you, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: class_a_07_ecology_answer_02
text:
It sure would be adorable if it were Pikachu in
our phones—and it would probably make us want
to walk around more, too!\c
But too bad, that’s not the right answer![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: class_a_07_ecology_answer_03
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Haha! I see where you’re coming from,
[VAR 0x0100(0000)]!\c
Heracross can learn a move called Smart Strike!
Smartphone, Smart Strike... Well, unfortunately,
there’s no connection![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: class_a_07_ecology_11
text: The Pokémon inside your smartphone is Rotom,\nand it does all sorts of things to help you out.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: class_a_07_ecology_12
text: A Rotom inside a Rotom Phone is special, so it\ndoesn’t try to enter other electronics.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: class_a_07_ecology_13
text: An ordinary Rotom, however, can change form by\nentering washing machines, microwave ovens,\r\nand other electronic appliances.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: class_a_07_ecology_14
text: Rotom is a bit of an exception, though. Many\nPokémon that change form do so simply by\r\nholding an item or by having one used on them.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: class_a_07_ecology_15
text: Oricorio, for example, has four different forms it\ncan change between when given certain nectars.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: class_a_07_ecology_16
text: Pokémon may even change type or learn\ndifferent moves when they change form.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: class_a_07_ecology_17
text:
Form changes are different from Evolution in that
the Pokémon can return to its original form.\c
And unlike Shiny Pokémon, which can’t change
their special coloration, the same individual
Pokémon can go back and forth between
its forms.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: class_a_07_ecology_18
text: There’s a lot to dig into with this form change\nphenomenon, as you can see![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: class_a_07_ecology_19
text: We can all learn something from Pokémon\nhere, don’t you think? Bit of a stretch, but...[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: class_a_07_ecology_20
text: I’d be happy to see you all enjoy your time at\nthe academy to the fullest...and change form\r\ninto a new version of yourselves![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: class_a_07_ecology_21
text: Or something like that, anyway![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: class_a_07_ecology_22
text: Oh! I almost forgot![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: class_a_07_ecology_23
text: Regional forms, which vary based on what region\na Pokémon came from, don’t change like other\r\nforms. They’re an innate—[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: class_a_07_ecology_24
text: Whoops. Heh...there’s the bell.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: class_a_07_ecology_25
text:
I guess I was scatterbrained Mr. Jacq right up to
the very end, huh?\c
I had a great time teaching all of you. I hope
you’ll do your best on the final exam![VAR 0x0114(002A)]
